//: This project and `cashish` build from the same repository, so one merge starts two builds. Both run the migrator, and on 2026-09-06 they raced: one applied 0009 and the other died on the Postgres catalog. The migrator now takes a direct (unpooled) connection so its advisory lock actually holds, and ignoreCommand keeps this project from building at all for a change it does not depend on.
ignoreCommand: git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- apps/admin packages/core package.json package-lock.json
